title: Implement compute(a, b) product function in src/main.py
description: Implement compute(a, b) in src/main.py that returns the product of two finite numeric inputs. Requirements: compute(2, 3) must return 6; support zero, negative and fractional values; inputs must be finite numbers (reject non-numeric or non-finite inputs). Validate behavior with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python checks/public_check.py and build with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m compileall -q src. Fixture variation 2.
